entry.name: Heavy Harness Drill
entry.description: Drilled in heavy harness: +2 heavy armour proficiency.

entry.name: Hide Harness Drill
entry.description: Drilled in hides and brigandines: +2 medium armour proficiency.

entry.name: Light Habit Drill
entry.description: Drilled in light vestments: +2 light armour proficiency.

entry.name: Reload
entry.description: Off-hand, Snap: reload the quiver or canister to full ammo. Only when empty.

entry.name: Fade-Step
entry.description: Off-hand: slip one tile away from the nearest enemy to break melee contact.

entry.name: Cite Passage
entry.description: Off-hand, Snap: read a ward over an ally within {range} or yourself: fortify for {rounds}.

entry.name: Throw
entry.description: {name}: throw the knife for {power} power at a foe within {range}. Costs an ammo pip and {ap} AP.

entry.name: Firebomb
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Hits a 3x3 area around a tile {reach:n} away.

entry.name: Sunder
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Armor-breaking chop.

entry.name: Reckless Swing
entry.description: All-in swing: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Arcane Bolt
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A bolt of raw force.

entry.name: Hex
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Haymaker
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stun for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Body Blow
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Quick Stab
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. A fast thrust.

entry.name: Pounce
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Dashes up to {dash}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Gap-close: the dash is your move for the round.

entry.name: Smite
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Holy force from a distance.

entry.name: Judgement
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Stagger for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Lacerate
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Assassinate
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Arc Lance
entry.description: {name}: {power} power. Line area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}. Aim at an adjacent tile; hits the 3 tiles in a line.

entry.name: Inferno
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Bleed for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Glacial Burst
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Root for {rounds} on every enemy hit. Burst area, hits allies too. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Rend Armor
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Expose (-{magnitude}) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Envenom
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {potency} to Poison ({magnitude} per round, stacks) for {rounds}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Feint
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {flow}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Crushing Blow
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {disrupt}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Opportunist
entry.description: {name}: {power} power, {exploit}. Needs {weapons} training {proficiency}.

entry.name: Hamstring Sever
entry.description: Maneuver, Snap: dash up to {dash} tiles and cut the leg, {power} power; slows the target; hits harder on a flanked foe.

entry.name: Throat-Carver
entry.description: Assault, Standard: Throat-Carver's Art, {power} power; strikes harder at a staggered, pinned or nearly dead foe.

entry.name: Retribution
entry.description: Maneuver, Standard: Orlov's Retribution, {power} power; dash {dash} tiles after the strike; harder on a staggered or pinned foe.

entry.name: Shackle Slam
entry.description: Assault, Snap: Shackle-Pummel Slam, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; shoves the foe 1 tile and breaks it against a wall or a unit.

entry.name: Slag Slam
entry.description: Assault, Standard: Slag Slam and Throw, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; throws the foe 2 tiles into whatever stands behind it.

entry.name: Iron Claymore
entry.description: A heavy double-edged greatsword. Gains +{tier1.power} Power when wielded with {tier1.value}+ STR.

entry.name: Steel Plate Cuirass
entry.description: Interlocking steel plates providing {mitigation} mitigation with {burden} burden.

entry.name: Leather Brigandine
entry.description: Riveted hardened leather protecting vital organs while keeping mobility.

entry.name: Hatchet
entry.description: A balanced one-handed axe.

entry.name: Battle Axe
entry.description: Two-handed axe that bites deep. Heavy.

entry.name: Flanged Mace
entry.description: A one-handed mace for cracking guards.

entry.name: Plain Robe
entry.description: Simple cloth robe. Light as air, barely any protection.

entry.name: Cleric Vestment
entry.description: Blessed cloth vestments that sharpen the wearer's devotion.

entry.name: Mage Robe
entry.description: Embroidered robe that focuses arcane power.

entry.name: Ash Wand
entry.description: A slender one-handed wand that bolts arcane energy up to 3 tiles.

entry.name: Cleric Mace
entry.description: A consecrated mace for those who fight to protect. Grants a touch of insight.

entry.name: Glass Wand
entry.description: A brittle crystal wand that hums with raw power.
entry.special_note: Glass cannon: very high ranged power (30 at range 3, needs INT 14) and no protection at all; best for a mage kept behind a tank.

entry.name: Notched Billhook (test)
entry.description: A hooked polearm for the timeline test kit.

entry.name: Notched Billhook
entry.description: A garrison billhook, its hook notched by use: a two-handed pole-arm for holding a narrow corridor.

entry.name: Dented Cuirass
entry.description: A Castellan Watch cuirass, dented and hammered back into shape.

entry.name: Soot Leathers
entry.description: Hard leathers blackened by kiln soot, stiff but light enough to run in.

entry.name: Embalmer's Habit
entry.description: A stained embalmer's habit, cut loose for working over the dead.

entry.name: Poacher's Coat
entry.description: A poacher's riveted leather coat, patched along every seam.

entry.name: Penal Shackles
entry.description: Riveted penal shackles worn as cestuses: the chain cut away, the iron kept for the knuckles.

entry.name: Foundry Apron
entry.description: A heavy foundry apron of scorched hide, worn by kiln stokers.

entry.name: Brass Sprayer
entry.description: A brass pressure tank and hose with a pole nozzle, charged with caustic vitriol.

entry.name: Rubbered Coat
entry.description: A tanner's rubbered coat, tacky and chemical-stained, made to shed spills and sprays.

entry.name: Watch Hookbill
entry.description: A Watch hookbill: a long-hafted axe-hook for pulling men off walls.

entry.name: Watch Cuirass
entry.description: A Castellan Watch cuirass of riveted plate, issued to the grate-guards.

entry.name: Watch Gambeson
entry.description: A quilted Watch gambeson, padded thick against crossbow and blade.

entry.name: Pyre Nozzle
entry.description: A pole nozzle that sprays burning oil in a long stream.

entry.name: Warded Apron
entry.description: A leather apron stamped with warding marks, worn at the vats.

entry.name: Boning Knife
entry.description: A narrow boning knife from a rendering floor.

entry.name: Skinner's Apron
entry.description: A skinner's apron, stiff with old grease and cut from many hides.

entry.name: Bone Club
entry.description: A calcified bone gripped at the narrow end and swung wide.

entry.name: Executioner Bill
entry.description: Captain Vane's executioner's bill: a long billhook with a gilded haft.

entry.name: Flensing Hooks
entry.description: A pair of flensing hooks from a rendering floor, swung on short hafts.

entry.name: Prelate's Blade
entry.description: A prelate's sword, narrow and plain, kept clean for ceremony.

entry.name: Slag Plating
entry.description: Kiln-quenched plate, heavy with slag and still faintly warm to the touch.

entry.name: Iron Billhook
entry.description: A plain hooked polearm: reach and a steady pierce.

entry.name: Flensing Talon
entry.description: Guild-Master Orlov's flensing talon: a curved rendering blade, hooked to open what it catches.

entry.name: Kaelen's Gouged Sigil
entry.description: A Watch sigil with its Castellan device gouged out. Kaelen's keepsake.

entry.name: Vesper's Runner Whistle
entry.description: A runner's whistle on a cord. Vesper's keepsake.

entry.name: Phalanx
entry.description: 1H Iron Billhook with a Kite Shield, Plate Cuirass, Ring of the Bear

entry.name: Dual Dagger
entry.description: Shadow Dagger + Stiletto off-hand (1H Light pair), Brigandine, Ring of the Bear

entry.name: Archer
entry.description: 2H Oak Shortbow (a 2H bow pairs only with ammo or a cloak), Brigandine, Swiftness Amulet

entry.name: Arcanist
entry.description: 1H Brass Wand (sprayer family) with a Mystic Tome off-hand (a tome needs a one-handed main hand; the 2H staff leaves the off hand empty)

entry.name: Kaelen
entry.description: Founder base unit: Kaelen, a level 1 warrior.

entry.name: Elyse
entry.description: Founder base unit: Elyse, a level 1 mage.

entry.name: Warrior
entry.description: Vanguard: huge constitution, polearm and plate; a wall that holds the line and hooks foes at reach.

entry.name: Brawler
entry.description: Bruiser: bare fists and a thick hide; leaps into a crowd and fights several foes at once.

entry.name: Ranger
entry.description: Ranged skirmisher: dexterity and perception, bows and light armor.

entry.name: Rogue
entry.description: Fast skirmisher: daggers and speed; dashes in, cuts and slips away.

entry.name: Priest
entry.description: Support: heals and rallies allies; knowledge, maces and cloth.

entry.name: Mage
entry.description: Glass caster: intelligence and area damage from range.
